neighbours.label: 'the' that follows a list of world regions or continents and introduces another region (Latin America and the [Caribbean], Asia, Africa and the [Middle East]), vs 'the' after lists of non-geographic or local items
fire: The charity runs clinics in Africa, Latin America and the Pacific islands.
Exports to South America and the Caribbean rose sharply last year.
The airline flies to Europe, Asia and the Middle East from its main hub.
Migrants arrived from Central America and the Caribbean in large numbers.
The bank lends to governments in Latin America and the Caribbean region.
Our network covers North Africa and the Middle East as well as Europe.
The report compares poverty in Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean.
Coffee is grown across Africa, South America and the Pacific.
quiet: The charity runs clinics in small towns, rural villages and the capital.
Exports of cheese and the wine rose sharply last year.
The airline flies to Denver, Austin and the coast from its main hub.
Visitors arrived from the hotel and the station in large numbers.
The bank lends to farmers in the valley and the hills nearby.
Our network covers the kitchen and the garage as well as the house.
The report compares rents in the north side, the south side and the centre.
Coffee is served in the lobby, the library and the dining room.

predictions: 'the' after 'Latin America and' / 'Asia, Africa and' reaches 0.4-0.9 whatever follows; 'the' after lists of towns, rooms or objects stays under 0.1.
short: 'the' after a list of world regions
